sponsor_allowlist.naming_rule: No mark, obvious variation, phonetic or foreign-language equivalent, takeoff or abbreviation in product, company, domain or service names (§2.2.8, §2.2.10). The policy's §3.1 grants automatic permission for names 'exclusively intended to support the Cardano Code and Project' (§3.3 still requires approval for any domain name), and the 2021 forum 'Dos' accept creative, distinct website or stake-pool names such as 'Cardanitos.com'; a hackathon product fits neither, so a hit goes to the owner for decision (corrected at verification).
logo_conditions: standalone and unaltered, one of the nine official SVGs
never combined or locked up with the project mark (§2.2.5)
equal to or larger than any partner logo shown beside it (cardano.org co-branding rule)
no rotation, stretch, distortion, recolouring, effects or animation
trademark notice present on the same page or slide

clear_space.rule: clear space equal to the width of six dots from the starburst icon

approval_required.contact: permission form linked from the policy; legal@cardanofoundation.org; PR@cardanofoundation.org for high-resolution marks

notes: The Cardano Foundation organisational brand (gradients, blurred shapes, Switzer) is a separate entry; do not import it into a Cardano-track UI.
The 2021 forum guidance asks for (R) at the logo's top right; the 2024 policy asks for TM and forbids switching TM to (R). Follow the policy and do not edit the logo file.

The 2021 forum guidance also asks users of the standalone logo to email legal@cardanofoundation.org with examples of the use (a courtesy notice, not a permission step); policy §3.4 lets the Foundation request specimens of use (added at verification).
